name: Paulus Potter
bio: Paulus Potter was a Dutch painter who specialized in landscapes featuring animals, often from a low vantage point.

paintings.title: The Young Bull
paintings.story: The Young Bull or The Bull is an oil painting of a bull by Paulus Potter. It is in the collection of the Mauritshuis in The Hague in the Netherlands.
